name: Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathy
definition: Autoimmune inflammatory muscle disease causing predominantly proximal weakness, with several modern subtypes and potential systemic complications.

investigations.principle: Laboratory, antibody, MRI and electrodiagnostic evaluation are subtype-directed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Immunosuppressive therapy requires subtype-specific monitoring and organ screening.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa-dhatu/Bala-kshaya phenotype may be explored only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Autoimmune inflammatory muscle disease causing predominantly proximal weakness, with several modern subtypes and potential systemic complications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
